# Leafcoin

> From roots to records. Explore Leafcoin, Ilya Papou's agrotech R&D concept combining aeroponics, IoT, ML calibration and verifiable crop records.

Leafcoin is presented as a concept and personal R&D project. The public Home Aeroponics materials document historical prototypes. The architecture and roadmap describe proposed work; implementation status beyond those materials is not established here. Besu with QBFT consensus is being considered as an option for a permissioned EVM network. Network governance, data visibility and any confidentiality mechanism would require separate evaluation. Token design and financial-integration feasibility remain research questions.

A proposed ML research loop would use repeated cultivation iterations to evaluate irrigation schedules and nutrient-solution composition against observed plant responses, with operator review of suggested adjustments.

## Languages

- [Spanish site](https://leafcoin.org/es/): Complete Spanish concept and article library, with the same source evidence and proposed-work scope.
- [Complete Spanish text](https://leafcoin.org/es/llms-full.txt): Spanish homepage and all four articles.

## Aeroponics learning library

These educational guides cite original research and institutional guidance. Findings from other studies are distinct from Leafcoin’s proposed research. Follow each article’s canonical HTML or complete Markdown; do not infer measured Leafcoin results from general agricultural literature.

- [Article library](https://leafcoin.org/articles/): Reading order and guide summaries.
- [What is aeroponics?](https://leafcoin.org/articles/what-is-aeroponics.html): Definitions, system components and the relationship to hydroponics and vertical farming. [Markdown](https://leafcoin.org/articles/what-is-aeroponics.md).
- [Aeroponics vs hydroponics](https://leafcoin.org/articles/aeroponics-vs-hydroponics.html): Potential advantages, experimental limits and fair comparison. [Markdown](https://leafcoin.org/articles/aeroponics-vs-hydroponics.md).
- [Aeroponic system control](https://leafcoin.org/articles/aeroponic-system-control.html): Delivery, solution chemistry, sensing and a proposed ML research loop. [Markdown](https://leafcoin.org/articles/aeroponic-system-control.md).
- [Future of aeroponics](https://leafcoin.org/articles/future-of-aeroponics.html): Propagation, resource accounting, economics and possible data-driven agriculture. [Markdown](https://leafcoin.org/articles/future-of-aeroponics.md).
- [All four articles as text](https://leafcoin.org/articles/llms-full.txt): Complete articles with source links and scope statements.
- [Whole-site text](https://leafcoin.org/llms-full.txt): Current concept presentation followed by the complete article library.
- [Library relationships](https://leafcoin.org/articles/library.jsonld): Collection, reading order and publisher identity.

## Concept resources

- [Complete concept in Markdown](https://leafcoin.org/index.md): Faithful text of the current homepage, including architecture details, proposed ML calibration research, proposed stages, prototype scope and image context.
- [Complete text in one file](https://leafcoin.org/llms-full.txt): Complete concept followed by the educational article library.
- [Structured concept graph](https://leafcoin.org/concept.jsonld): Distinct concept, creator, historical prototype, repository, image and source identities.
- [Human-readable homepage](https://leafcoin.org/): The canonical visual presentation.

## Prototype evidence

- [Aeroponics IoT control](https://github.com/pilprod/aeroponics-iot-control): Historical Python and MQTT controller examples with monitoring and integration context.
- [Aeroponics sensor firmware](https://github.com/pilprod/aeroponics-sensor-firmware): Archived Arduino experiments for sensing, telemetry and relay control.
- [Home Aeroponics lab](https://papou.work/portfolio.html#home): Context and photographs from the broader historical personal installation; repository build, runtime and hardware limitations remain relevant.
